questions.q: An employee clicks a link during a simulated phishing exercise. Which type of training is required?
questions.explain: An observed mistake triggers corrective training. Targeted training addresses a role-specific risk.

questions.q: Which channel tracks courses, certifications, and employee progress?
questions.explain: A learning management system (LMS) centralizes courses, tracking, and certifications. Concept from objective 5.6 (beyond textbooks).

questions.q: Match each scenario to the appropriate training type.

pairs.left: First week of a new hire
BEC session for the accounting department
Mistake sending data to the wrong recipient

questions.explain: The trigger determines the type: onboarding, schedule, role risk, or mistake.

questions.q: Which topics are common security awareness themes? (Select all that apply)
questions.explain: Vendor lock-in belongs to third-party risk (5.3), not awareness topics in objective 5.6.

questions.q: Which metric shows that employees are actively reporting phishing attempts?
questions.explain: The reporting rate measures active vigilance. A low click rate does not prove that alerts are being reported.

questions.q: Which deliverable summarizes program trends for leadership?
questions.explain: The managerial report presents trends, risks, and decisions to be made based on metrics.
